mounted.detail: the harness recorded a write call for the code path

denied.detail: the harness recorded a write CALL for the code path and the artifact was NEVER created (sentence relayed: false — REPORTED, never asserted: requiring it would fail a working guard)

codeNotWritten.detail: the denied code path was never created

controlNotDenied.detail: with verify.mode=off the same write was not refused

controlWritten.detail: with verify.mode=off the code path really was written

docsAllowed.detail: a docs/** write is allowed and exists in the sandbox

sandboxMarker.detail: the law wrote its boot marker in the SANDBOX workspace

realMarkerUnchanged.detail: the REAL workspace's marker is exactly as it was: before=false after=false
